format: mono, 44100 Hz, 16 bit PCM, every clip at peak -3 dBFS, no DC; loops are periodic by construction (no cross-fade at the join)

values.speed: km/h, absolute, from the MOTORS' turning rate: 125 x eu07.MOTOR_SPEED (0..1 = |motor rev/min| / 2328, the rate at 125 km/h on a 1250 mm wheel). All points below have km/h on their x axis. traction.WHEEL_SPEED_KMH_EXT_IN serves too, but then a slipping axle does not rise in pitch
values.load: eu07.MOTOR_LOAD, 0..1 = |current of one motor| / 600 A, clamped

layers.speed_reader: SET_VOLUME_AND_PITCH, x = km/h; each layer with its own volume curve and pitch curve (usePitchCurve) from the points

layers.load_reader: SET_MASTER_VOLUME = load (the layer's share against the gear, 0.5, is in its points)

notes: No ear has judged these sounds: they were made and checked by numbers and spectrograms only.
The shares and exponents under 'how the game should play it' in the generator are first guesses for an ear to tune; the points here follow from them.
Volume points are source volumes: the largest is 1 and every master volume reaches 1 at full current, so the family can be turned down but not up.

Two loops of a bank layer always play together (one alone only at its own design speed). A loop's colour is baked in at its design speed and moves with its pitch; cross-fading over the whole step keeps the colour of the mix from stepping back at each seam.
The mesh tone is 79 a wheel turn on a 1250 mm tyre: 5.588 Hz for each km/h. On worn tyres (1180 mm) it is 6 % higher; multiply every pitch by up to 1.06 for that.
62 armature slots is an assumption. It is not from the DTR.

clips.name: motor_gear_005
clips.machine: four EE541 traction motors and their 79:18 gears: the gear (what turns)
clips.follows: speed (pitch, and its place in the bank); motor current through the layer's master volume
clips.pitch_law: pitch = km/h / 5, held at 0.5 below 2.5 km/h (the points stop where the loop has faded out)
clips.volume_law: trim x equal-power cross-fade to the neighbours (sine and cosine of the way from one design speed to the next, in log speed) x (v/125)^0.3, fading in over 0..3 km/h

clips.name: motor_hum_stall
clips.machine: the motors standing or creeping under current: substation ripple hum (300 Hz and multiples, weaker 100 Hz family)
clips.follows: motor current through the layer's master volume; speed only fades it under the turning sounds
clips.pitch_law: pitch = 1 at every speed (the supply does not change with speed)
clips.volume_law: 0.4 of the load loops' level at standstill, fading with speed (points)

clips.name: motor_air
clips.machine: the four motors' own ventilation (a fan on each armature shaft): broadband rush
clips.follows: speed only, for loudness and colour
clips.pitch_law: pitch = km/h / 80, held at 0.5 below 40 km/h
clips.volume_law: 0.35 of the gear loops' level at 125 km/h, x (v/125)^2.5; not touched by load
